title: Chinese "Imaginative Realism"
content: Shanghai People’s Fine Arts Publishing Househas just published a Chinese edition ofImaginative Realism: How to Paint What Doesn't Exist.The layout of the book is the same as the English edition, but the dimensions are a little smaller. As far as we know, this edition will only be available in China.----The English language edition is available through Amazonorsigned from the Dinotopia Store-------Review of I.R. on Lines and ColorsPreviously on GurneyJourney:Watercolor painting in old ShanghaiChinese magazine interview about sketchingJapanese edition of Imaginative Realism
